scheme_name: Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme For Seafarers
description:
The Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers was launched by the Government of Goa on December 1, 2019.

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to seafarers who have served on merchant ships and have contributed to the state's economy.

The primary objective of the scheme is to ensure that retired seafarers receive a monthly pension to support their livelihood after their years of service.

Under this scheme, eligible seafarers receive a pension of ₹5,000 per month.

The scheme is designed to benefit seafarers who have completed a minimum of 10 years of service in the maritime industry.

The age limit for eligibility under this scheme is set at 60 years.

Seafarers must have served on Indian or foreign merchant vessels to qualify for the pension.

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of their service in the form of discharge books or certificates issued by their employers.

The application process for the Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers involves several steps.

First, applicants must obtain the application form from the Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa.

The application form can also be downloaded from the official website of the Directorate of Fisheries.

Once the application form is completed, it must be submitted along with required documents.

Required documents include proof of age, proof of service, and a bank account statement.

The completed application must be submitted to the office of the Directorate of Fisheries.

After submission, the application will be reviewed by the authorities.

Eligible applicants will be notified about the approval of their pension.

Pensions are disbursed on a monthly basis.

The disbursement is typically made through direct bank transfers to the beneficiaries' bank accounts.

The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa.

The contact details for the Directorate of Fisheries are as follows: Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa, EDC Complex, Patto Plaza, Panaji, Goa - 403001.

The phone number for inquiries is +91 832 222 4710.

The email address for the Directorate of Fisheries is fisheries.goa@gmail.com.

The scheme is part of the government's broader initiative to support the welfare of workers in various sectors.

The Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers reflects the government's commitment to ensuring social security for its citizens.

As of October 2023, the scheme has seen a growing number of beneficiaries.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹2 crore for the implementation of this scheme for the financial year 2023-2024.

The scheme aims to reach at least 1,000 seafarers in its first year of implementation.

The government has also conducted awareness programs to inform seafarers about the benefits of the scheme.

These programs are held in various coastal areas of Goa where seafarers are known to reside.

The scheme has received positive feedback from the seafaring community in Goa.

Many beneficiaries have expressed gratitude for the financial support provided by the government.

The pension amount is intended to help cover basic living expenses for retired seafarers.

The government is continuously evaluating the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and reach.

The Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers is a significant step towards recognizing the contributions of seafarers to the economy.

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also acknowledges the sacrifices made by seafarers and their families.

The government has emphasized the importance of supporting seafarers as they often face challenges during their service.

The scheme is a part of a larger framework of welfare initiatives aimed at various sectors in Goa.

The government is committed to enhancing the quality of life for all its residents, including those in the maritime sector.

In addition to the pension scheme, the government is exploring other welfare measures for seafarers.

These measures may include health insurance and skill development programs.

The Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers is a crucial component of the state's social security system.

The government aims to ensure that no seafarer is left without support after retirement.

The scheme is expected to evolve based on feedback from beneficiaries and changing needs.

The government is also looking into increasing the pension amount in future budgets.

The Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers serves as a model for other states to consider similar initiatives.

The scheme highlights the importance of recognizing and supporting those who contribute to the maritime industry.

The government has set a goal to increase awareness about the scheme to ensure maximum participation.

The scheme is a testament to the government's dedication to the welfare of its citizens.

The implementation of the scheme is monitored by a dedicated team within the Directorate of Fisheries.

The team is responsible for processing applications and ensuring timely disbursement of pensions.

The Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers is an essential step towards building a more inclusive society.

The government encourages all eligible seafarers to apply for the benefits provided under this scheme.

The scheme is part of Goa's efforts to enhance social welfare and support for all its residents.

The government remains committed to the welfare of seafarers and their families.

The Goa Welfare / Pension Scheme for Seafarers is a significant achievement in the realm of social security in the state.

The government continues to work towards improving the lives of those who have dedicated their lives to serving at sea.
